method: nonnegative masked Abel fit with spatial regularization and spherical prior in unobserved regions

geometry.scaleSource: NASA ACME CFI-G 6.35 mm burner; provisional 96 px image diameter, not a calibrated camera measurement

radiometry.units: linear INTNS counts / displayCounts / local path length
radiometry.detectionRule: 5 sigma of the measured dark-frame mean over the same observation mask

flowTimingSource: longest sustained raw MFCA3FuelFlow plateau (transients excluded), aligned by wall clock
